snippet.title: Sea of Thieves Season 17: Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Sea of Thieves Season 17: Smugglers' Tide has started!

🕵️ The Smugglers' League Arrives
💥 Black Powder Barrels
🗺️ Smugglers' Route Runs
🧥 New Cosmetics
💯 100 Levels of Seasonal Rewards
🤠 Emporium Refresh
🏴‍☠️ Pirate Profiles
🖼️ And more to come: https://seaofthieves.com/season-17

----------------------------------------

PLAY SEA OF THIEVES
Explore a vast open world in the ultimate pirate adventure game, available to buy on Xbox, PS5, Win 10/11 and Steam and Battle.net. Set sail and forge your own legend: https://www.seaofthieves.com/buy
